rows.description: City Commission: Amendment No. 1 to agreement with Man Con, Inc. setting a guaranteed maximum price for construction manager at risk services for the Historic Marine Way seawall; largest figure in item $55,409,005. Outcome not verified.
rows.shortfall: Delray Beach Commissioner Casale puts the Amendment 3 loss estimate closer to $11M than $21M (Nov 12).
rows.needs_review: Item text is cut off; $55,409,005 is the largest figure in it, not a confirmed GMP. Publish as described?

rows.description: City Commission: Addendum No. 3 to the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office contract for law enforcement services, $6,479,308 for FY27 (16.63% of general fund). Outcome not verified.

City Council item 10a: one-year renewal of the agreement with C.W. Roberts Contracting, Inc. for Transportation Rehabilitation Improvement Program projects, not to exceed $6,000,000 (4.06% of general fund). Outcome not verified.
BCC: Guaranteed Maximum Price of $12,215,498.56 with Wharton-Smith of Sanford, FL (CMAR Work Order No. 4) to build new Fire Station 25 at 105 Wilshire Boulevard, Casselberry. Result: Pass per clerk.
rows.shortfall: Nov 10 (WFTV): County projects a 27% drop in county property tax revenue; Sheriff Lemma expects significant position cuts.

rows.description: City Commission: awards ITB26-025, SE 6th Terrace New Bridge Replacement, to lowest responsive bidder General Asphalt Co. LLC, $8,530,065.20. Outcome not verified.

BCC: awards IFB Y25-1056-JA, Class III landfill disposal of construction, demolition and yard waste material, to low bidder Hubbard Construction Company d/b/a Mid Florida Materials, estimated $10,080,000 over five years. Result: Pass per clerk.

BCC: awards IFB Y25-102-GO, Traffic Engineering Construction, to low bidders Mercon Construction Company ($12,934,487) and Condor Construction, Corp. ($14,992,447.50), each for five years, $27,926,934.50 combined. Result: Pass per clerk.

CRA Board item 6.01: recommendation for approval of a New Construction Assistance Program grant of $750,000 for 115 West Harrison Street (2.2% of Tallahassee's special revenue funds). Outcome not verified.
City Commission: contract for sale and purchase with OT Property Group, LLC to buy property at 134 NE 3rd Street, $5,000,000 from the Parking Fund. Result: Pass per clerk.

City Commission: Amendment No. 1 with Kiewit Corporation setting a Guaranteed Maximum Price of $112,973,126 for CMAR construction of the Northwest Neighborhood Improvements Project, revised agreement total $113,736,942. Outcome not verified.
rows.shortfall: Nov 12 (Florida Today): Delray Mayor Carney "still kind of in a fog"; Commissioner Casale puts the $21M loss estimate closer to $11M.

rows.description: City Council: approves a sponsorship proposal for the PGA TOUR Enterprises, Inc. Cadillac Championship and a nonexclusive, temporary, revocable parking license to PGA Tour Enterprises; authorizes spending budgeted funds. Amount not in item text. Outcome not verified.

BCC: approves the Orange County Sheriff's Office spending $2,500 from the FY 2026 Law Enforcement Trust Fund (state forfeitures) for a contribution to the National Latino Peace Officers Association. Result: Pass per clerk.

BCC: Sheriff's Office to spend $164,000 in FY 2026 state forfeiture trust funds on contributions: VERB Kind Berk Golf Classic $2,500, Boy Scouts Golden Eagle Dinner $17,500, Harbor House walk $1,500, S.A. Casey Construction ballistic storefront $140,000, NAMI $2,500. Result: Pass per clerk.

CRA Greater Frenchtown/Southside Citizens' Advisory Committee: request for $750,000 in CRA grant funds for the WeWould REIT, LLC retail development, total project cost $3.06 million (2.2% of Tallahassee's special revenue funds). Outcome not verified.

City Commission: Ordinance 2025-466 authorizes borrowing and issuing debt up to $35,500,000 for capital improvements, including the second construction phase at Jackie Robinson Ballpark stadium; record lists it as adopted. May repeat an existing entry (2026-01-07).

County Commission: open-end contract to low bidder Rosco Collision Avoidance LLC for a collision avoidance detection system and support for BCT buses (FTA), initial year $7,606,285, five-year estimate $9,074,685. Outcome not verified.

City Commission: award of RFP25-001 Oceanside Parking Garage design-build project to The Whiting-Turner Contracting Co., $32,876,690 (design $3,037,041 available; construction $29,839,649 financed). Result: Fail per clerk.
